brief_summary: A do/don't map with two columns. The terracotta 'good fit for' column lists firm direct typing feel, ambient per-key glow, and patient aftermarket hunting. The warm-red 'skip it for' column lists wanting a cushioned keystroke, wanting lit-up legends, and wanting the parts list ordered in one sitting.
